record.question: When a contractual dispute arises, the Engineer-in-Charge shall promptly deal with the dispute to prevent further escalation. Which one of the following actions of the Engineer-in-Charge is inappropriate:
options: When a claim raised by the contractor is within the competency of the Engineer-in-Charge, he shall decide within 15 days and convey his decision to the contractor on time.
The Engineer-in-Charge shall always maintain a separate file for the dispute that crop up during the progress of the work.
The Engineer-in-Charge shall invariably keep the client department informed about the entire dispute resolution process from the start of dispute till the payment of arbitration award.
In the case of his transfer or relinquishing of charge due to any reason, he shall prepare. a self-contained comprehensive note on the claims and hand over the same to the Conciliator.
record.explanation: Handing the note to the conciliator is inappropriate.
